name: Noehon
description: The Noehons were sentient arboreal insectoids indigenous to Noe'ha'on. Noehons were well-known throughout the galaxy as a species of slaves and slave-traders. Their culture was often considered brutal and violent, though Noehons raised away from Noe'ha'on's rigid, hierarchical society showed a talent for organization which served them well in technical and bureaucratic fields.

data.name: Noehon
data.distinctions: Four-armed insectoids, musk glands, slave society
